INTACT.meaning: the intact control, identical to the SCI-WS-OSC-1 SINGLE_AREA construction in every array; only retention and the record differ

authority: owner 2026-09-19: SCI-EI-REGIME-1 authorized with B1_CLASS_TARGETS ratified as project truth (B1-CLASS-TARGETS-RATIFIED) and the driver fork authorized under the HD-ARM-DRIVER-SHADOWED-G pattern. C1_tonic.predicate: realized effective drive (configured emitter tonic plus mean synaptic current) below fresh single-cell rheobase for PV and VIP; configured tonic reported alongside so the two cannot be confused
C1_tonic.support: SUPPORTED iff realized PV < rheobase_PV and realized VIP < rheobase_VIP, rheobase = lowest battery_b1 F-I current with rate above 1 Hz

C2_weights.predicate: realized E-to-I authority: mean realized E->PV and E->VIP weights against mean realized E->E weights, read from the compiling edge list
C2_weights.support: SUPPORTED iff mean E->PV and mean E->VIP are both below mean E->E

C3_parameters.predicate: actual built Izhikevich (a,b) per inhibitory class against canonical fast-spiking (0.10, 0.20) for PV and low-threshold spiking (0.02, 0.25) for SST; VIP values reported with no canonical type and no verdict contribution
C3_parameters.support: SUPPORTED iff PV (a,b) differs from FS or SST (a,b) differs from LTS, exact on the configured constants

C4_suppression.predicate: temporal evidence, not coexistence: SST full-run rate above the B1 SST top with a present SST->PV/VIP anatomical path, PV/VIP net synaptic current negative while their tonic is positive, and SST already dominant in the first 2000 ms post-settle
C4_suppression.support: SUPPORTED iff all four hold: SST rate above 12.0 Hz, both SST weight sums positive, PV and VIP net currents negative with positive tonic, SST early rate above 12.0 Hz and above five times the larger of PV/VIP early rates
